basic_details.job_title: GFGC Madhugiri Guest Lecturer Recruitment 2026 – Walkin
basic_details.short_information: Tumkur University (Tumakuru Vishwavidyanilaya) will hold a walk-in interview on Monday, 16 November 2026 for Guest Lecturer (Athithi Upanyasakaru) posts in its postgraduate LL.M. department; candidates must report at 9.30 AM at the Development Section of Tumkur University for document verification, and the interview is at 11.30 AM in the Hon'ble Vice-Chancellor's chamber, Tumkur University, B.H. Road, Tumakuru. There are 2 part-time posts for the 2026-27 academic year, open to candidates with a postgraduate degree in the relevant subject and NET/KSET/Ph.D, as per UGC regulations.

rows.details: 09.30 AM for document verification, Development Section, Tumkur University
Hon'ble Vice-Chancellor's Chamber, Tumkur University, B.H. Road, Tumakuru
Guest Lecturer, PG Department of LL.M. (Part-time)
Candidates eligible as per UGC regulations with PG degree (55% / 50% for SC/ST) and NET/KSET/Ph.D

content_sections.heading: About the University
content_sections.text: Tumkur University is a university with its office on B.H. Road, Tumakuru - 572 103, Karnataka. This notice has been issued by the Deputy Registrar of the university's Development Section, by order, to fill guest lecturer posts in the postgraduate LL.M. department for the 2026-27 academic year.

content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: Tumkur University needs 2 part-time Guest Lecturers for the postgraduate LL.M. department for the 2026-27 academic year. The appointment is made as per UGC regulations. A postgraduate degree in the relevant subject with 55% marks for General and other category candidates. A postgraduate degree in the relevant subject with 50% marks for Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe candidates. NET/KSET/Ph.D qualification. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility for the LL.M. Guest Lecturer posts.

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: Every candidate attending the walk-in for the Guest Lecturer post must bring a demand draft (DD) for the applicable fee, drawn in the name of "Finance Officer, Tumkur University, Tumakuru". The fee will not be refunded for any reason.

rows.category: Scheduled Caste, Scheduled Tribe and Category-1
rows.fee: Rs. 250-00/- (Two hundred and fifty rupees only)

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: Original documents. One set of xerox copies of the documents. Demand draft of the prescribed fee in favour of "Finance Officer, Tumkur University, Tumakuru" (not needed for persons with disabilities, who pay no fee).

content_sections.heading: What Happens on the Day
content_sections.text: Report at 9.30 AM on 16 November 2026 at the Development Section of Tumkur University. Present your original documents, the set of xerox copies and the fee DD for document verification. Attend the walk-in interview at 11.30 AM in the Hon'ble Vice-Chancellor's chamber, Tumkur University, B.H. Road, Tumakuru.

faq.question: Q1. When is the Tumkur University Guest Lecturer walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on Monday, 16 November 2026, at 11.30 AM.

faq.question: Q2. What is the reporting time and where should candidates report?
faq.answer: Candidates must report at 9.30 AM on 16 November 2026 at the Development Section of Tumkur University for document verification; the interview is in the Hon'ble Vice-Chancellor's chamber, Tumkur University, B.H. Road, Tumakuru.

faq.question: Q3. How many Guest Lecturer posts are there?
faq.answer: There are 02 (two) part-time Guest Lecturer posts in the postgraduate LL.M. department.

faq.question: Q4. What qualification is needed?
faq.answer: A postgraduate degree in the relevant subject with 55% marks (General and other categories) or 50% marks (SC/ST), along with NET/KSET/Ph.D, as per UGC regulations.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs. 500-00/- for General candidates and Rs. 250-00/- for SC, ST and Category-1 candidates; persons with disabilities pay no fee.

faq.question: Q6. How is the fee paid?
faq.answer: By demand draft in the name of "Finance Officer, Tumkur University, Tumakuru", brought to the walk-in; the fee is non-refundable.

faq.question: Q7. Which documents should candidates bring?
faq.answer: Original documents with one set of xerox copies and the fee DD.

faq.question: Q8. Are the posts full-time?
faq.answer: No, the notice describes the 2 posts as part-time, for the 2026-27 academic year.
